findings.Text: B13 estimate: 7.5 potions per manual meadow hour at 5 kills/min (assumed 1 king slime per 8 kills); 18.0 at Config.Economy.KillsPerMinute 12. Target 8-14/h: re-measure in the 15-minute hand run.

contract: A23-11 / A23-12 / A23-14 + review B1-B13 (2026-10-05): one own server roll per kill contributor; items auto-granted, never lost; enhance scrolls 70% +1 / 30% +3 / 10% +5, failure 50% -1 (never below +0) else kept, max +10, refused at +10; transfer scrolls 70/30/10% ADD the source +N onto the target up to +10 and leave the rest on the source (lossless), refused when the target is +10 or the source +0, failure changes nothing but uses the scroll; scrolls refused in PvP combat (kept); equip needs a living character and no PvP combat, MinLevel gates purchases only (owned weapons re-equip at any level); drop tables: scroll chances rise with the zone (reviewer B2 table, transfer ~1/3), potions halved; legendary damage 76 = 2 x tier 3; PowerOf includes enhancement (Justice/PvP read the WeaponEnhance attribute); owner-only Inventory remote { Items = known ids, Enhance = 8 tiers } replaces ItemsJson/EnhanceJson; unknown saved ids kept but hidden; full notices once per item id per 5 min (info); FirstScroll flag only on a real grant (6 s guide, Fx First); LootRoll debug is count-only; rebirth resets only Level/XP (gold, weapons, enhancement, items kept); first BigSlime = one Enh70 once; Slime jackpot tier 8 at 1/20000 (x3 golden); duplicate weapons -> gold; materials sold only at the anvil, removed before payment. A23-15: a new non-jackpot weapon drop of grade rank >= Config.Announce.MinWeaponGrade (3 = Rare) -> AnnounceService.Announce(player, "RareWeapon", { Weapon, Monster }, grade id), Common/Fine never; a new jackpot legendary -> exactly one "Jackpot" { Weapon } (grade Legend), ownership saved first, a duplicate jackpot = gold only, no Net.NotifyAll; the first weapon to reach +10 per player (enhance or transfer scroll) sets LootFlags.FirstMax then announces "FirstMax" { Weapon } once (saved, survives reload); a missing or failing AnnounceService never blocks the grant.
limitations: Offline service doubles (DataStore = JSON round trip, rate limit clock, ShopService.CanBuyWeapon and CombatService.IsInCombat stubbed for LootService, AnnounceService a recording stub (its 10 s grouping, name hiding and client chat text are not exercised), a stand-in character for Util.IsAlive, task.defer flushed by the fixture, Inventory remote captured). Justice/PvP power helpers are extracted functions, not the whole services. Client item panel, Fx, real MonsterService kills, multiplayer and Studio play are not certified here.
